name: Agent Ops Prompt Generator
tagline: Local-first Korean prompt generator for AI coding agent operations work
description: Agent Ops Prompt Generator is a free, open-source browser tool for creating Korean prompts used with AI coding agents during operational work. It helps developers produce structured instructions for incident triage, deployment smoke checks, code review, production data correction, and handoff summaries without sending user input to a server.

features.title: Operations Prompt Builder
features.description: Generates structured Korean prompts for incident triage, deployment checks, reviews, data fixes, and handoffs

features.title: Local-First Browser Flow
features.description: Runs as a static page and keeps entered operational context inside the browser

features.title: No Account Required
features.description: Works without login, server setup, or external API keys

features.title: Copy-Ready Output
features.description: Formats prompts so they can be pasted directly into AI coding agents

notes.text: The tool is static and can be run from GitHub Pages or any static file host.
